Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated the film in the query (“Der Blindgänger”) with the search result for “Blindgänger (2024)” and prematurely treated Kerstin Polte as the director of the asked-about title without disambiguating the exact film (title/article/year). This misidentification set the investigation on the wrong film/director and led to subsequent looping and nationality checks on the incorrect target, undermining the ability to answer whether both films’ directors are from the same country.
